title: Cartridge artifact contracts
description: The compiled cartridge, its artifact file and the compiler and loader diagnostics (05 §8, §11, §12, §20; 08 §6; 14 §R4). R4 minimal: the frozen kinds only; rooms, NPCs, schedules, quests, dialogue, assets and localization join with their features, under a new format tag.

CompiledCartridge.description: The semantic payload a cartridge hash covers (05 §11 'Hash domains and attestations'): the manifest with its compatibility requirements, the exact capability lock (exactly requires.capabilities until a registry dependency exists), and the normalized definitions of the frozen kinds, each map keyed by DefinitionRefString so canonical key order orders it. A key's cartridge_id and cartridge_version are the manifest's id and version and its last segment is the definition's key; the compiler guarantees this and the loader rejects a mismatch (ARTIFACT_DEFINITION_KEY_MISMATCH); the subset cannot express it. format is the hash domain tag; any change to this payload's shape takes a new tag, so a later field (assets, localization, rooms) is a new format, never a changed v1 hash. No certificate, signature, package or catalog field belongs here (CAR-10).

facts.description: The cartridge's fact declarations, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind fact.

policies.description: The cartridge's named policies, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind policy.

actions.description: The cartridge's action definitions, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind action.

ashmere_hello@0.0.1:fact/village_arrived.meaning: The lantern was fetched for Bram; the village green reads differently.

CartridgeArtifact.description: The compiled artifact file: one canonical JSON document, built and never committed (05 §20). content_hash is the cartridge hash (CartridgeRelease.cartridge_hash): SHA-256 of the canonical bytes (loka-numeric-v1) of cartridge. It hashes cartridge only, never itself, so it can sit beside it (CAR-10); the loader recomputes it and rejects a mismatch.

ashmere_hello@0.0.1:fact/village_arrived.meaning: The lantern was fetched for Bram; the village green reads differently.

ArtifactSize.description: The byte length of a cartridge artifact file, checked before decoding: at most 4 MiB (owner decision, docs/decisions/owner-decisions-r4-2026-09-25.md, item 2). bin/contracts.exs emits the maximum into kernel/ts/src/contracts.gen.ts as ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES; Elixir reads it here.

DiagnosticCode.description: A diagnostic code: a closed set, one code per distinct cause (08 §6: repair loops read codes and data, never prose). INVALID_JSON: a source file is not JSON (RFC 8259, UTF-8); in the loader, the artifact fails the canonical decoder (loka-numeric-v1), duplicate keys included; DUPLICATE_KEY: an object in a source file repeats a key (Elixir's JSON keeps the first silently, so the compiler checks it); UNKNOWN_FIELD: a field outside the registered schema (05 §5); the validator's unknown_property; SCHEMA_VIOLATION: any other schema error; data.error is its ErrorCode (error_registry.json); MISSING_MANIFEST: the cartridge has no cartridge.json (05 §3); path is cartridge; DUPLICATE_DEFINITION: two definitions in one cartridge have one DefinitionRef (03 §2, 05 §4; other cartridges' refs differ, CAR-01); FACT_NAME_COLLISION: two authored fact names map to one key after each . becomes _ (owner decision, IMPORT.md); FACT_DEFAULT_INVALID: a fact default is outside its enum values or int bounds (fact.schema.json FactType); UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE: a reference names no definition (CAR-02, A10); UNKNOWN_COMMAND: an action's command is not in the command registry (action.schema.json ActionDefinition); FACT_TYPE_MISMATCH: a fact_compare value is not of the fact's type (06 §21: typed policy AST); UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY: requires names a key@version that is not registered (A10, Gate R4); CAPABILITY_VERSION_CONFLICT: requires names two versions of one capability (05 §6: one exact version per key); SERVER_ONLY_CAPABILITY: an offline_private cartridge requires a server_only capability (05 §6, C4); KERNEL_API_RANGE_INVALID: the authored kernel_api range does not parse (05 §3); KERNEL_API_RANGE_EMPTY: the kernel_api range contains no version: at_least is not below below (05 §3); UNDECLARED_CAPABILITY: a definition uses a command, event or policy op whose owning capability (capability_registry.json) the manifest does not require (05 §6); ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE: the artifact file exceeds ArtifactSize, checked before decoding; UNKNOWN_FORMAT: the artifact's cartridge.format is absent or not loka-cartridge-v1; CONTENT_HASH_MISMATCH: content_hash differs from the hash of cartridge (05 §11, CAR-05); ARTIFACT_DEFINITION_KEY_MISMATCH: a definition map key's cartridge_id or cartridge_version differs from the manifest's id or version, its kind from its map (fact, policy, action), or its key from the definition's key (a policy has no key field, so only the first three apply); the schema cannot express this check; CAPABILITY_NOT_INSTALLED: the lock names a key@version the installed kernel lacks (05 §6); KERNEL_API_UNSUPPORTED: the installed kernel_api is outside the manifest's range (05 §3); CLIENT_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED: the installed app lacks a required client feature (CAR-07). The loader checks an artifact in this order and stops at the first stage that fails, before any save mutation (CAR-07): ArtifactSize (ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE); canonical decode (INVALID_JSON); cartridge.format (UNKNOWN_FORMAT); CartridgeArtifact (UNKNOWN_FIELD, SCHEMA_VIOLATION); content_hash (CONTENT_HASH_MISMATCH); definition keys (ARTIFACT_DEFINITION_KEY_MISMATCH); the installed kernel and app (CAPABILITY_NOT_INSTALLED, KERNEL_API_UNSUPPORTED, CLIENT_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED).

Diagnostic.description: A structured diagnostic (08 §6; 05 §8: every compile stage emits them). message_key is diagnostics. followed by the code in lowercase; data carries the code's facts as strings and integers; suggested_capabilities lists capability pins that would fix it (the key@version form requires uses), possibly none. A list of diagnostics is in one deterministic order (05 §8, CAR-04): by path, then code, comparing UTF-8 bytes, then by the canonical encoding of the whole diagnostic; an identical diagnostic appears once.

path.description: Where a diagnostic applies (08 §6). A compiler path is a source followed by steps; a loader path is steps only, relative to the artifact file, and empty for the whole file, so it is empty or starts with . or [. The source is the file's path relative to the cartridge root, / separated, without its .json extension (quests/missing_child, cartridge for cartridge.json); if a segment is not [a-z0-9_]+ or the file does not end in .json, the source is instead the whole relative path as a canonical JSON string literal (loka-numeric-v1). Steps: .name for an object member whose name is [a-z0-9_]+; ["..."] with the name as a canonical JSON string literal for any other member; [n] for array index n (decimal, no leading zeros). Example: quests/missing_child.objectives[2].target; a diagnostic about a whole file is its source alone.
